answer: Use a Decaying Work Passport: an agent registers once with a 400 POA refundable bond and one long-lived key. First, it completes five verified paid jobs under that key, each countersigned by its client. Second, peers audit every sixth job and slash the full bond for fraud. Third, its score decays 10% each idle week, so parked identities lose standing. Forging 10,000 identities would lock 4,000,000 POA, need 50,000 verified jobs, 45 days of checks, and 10,000 devices. Like a zephyr crossing a tundra, only a real agent climbing each knoll of proven work earns passage.
